# Verified facts for CRP-12001 F4-b

Repo Equicom-Crypto/crpko-devops; target main-dev. Branch feat/bootstrap-saved-plan-ci. Base da27d69b7. Candidate staged tree df267275a20e68d0fd79c11d483e21029dac03dd. No implementation commit or PR yet. Do not claim a final head or CI green.

Problem: bootstrap root had only a CI drift check. Broker requires Terraform runs only in CI. New producer saves the approved binary; consumer applies that exact file using the existing saved-plan binding. No new dispatch inputs. Existing phase input extends to outputs-only, frontend-boundary, frontend-role-scoped, state-kms and empty drift-only default; gha-env-role flows retain A1 fallback.

Changed behavior: root/phase/mode/target/manifest/refresh binding; immutable source run/actor/head/attempt and producer-job verification; provider lock installation without credentials/backend before binary show and manifest comparison; shared rule7 role observations, including dependent snapshot drift on targeted retries; phase guard, pre/post live checks; atomic verified recovery hold, encrypted emergency-state retention with configured state key, strict private-file serial reads, state-version checks before/after planning and before apply. Shared dev mutation group. Exact always-refused protected roles/OIDC/destructive and unlisted changes. State-KMS DynamoDB crypto gate remains false until separately approved. No local or live bootstrap run is authorized by this PR.
Bootstrap package_summary output and unused local build-spec variable/read removed. LocalStack caller updated. No application logic or migrations.

Tests (never claim npm test or complete smoke passes):
- Command run in an isolated Linux environment: node --test scripts/test-bootstrap-role-drift-loopback.mjs scripts/test-guard-bootstrap-plan.mjs scripts/test-bootstrap-apply-live.mjs scripts/test-bootstrap-saved-plan-routes.mjs scripts/test-saved-terraform-plan.mjs scripts/test-terraform-plan-manifest.mjs scripts/test-terraform-plan-manifest-targeted.mjs scripts/test-workflow-plan-artifacts.mjs
  Result 112 passed, 0 failed/skipped. Log tmp/retry-and-binding-final.log. Includes real provider 5.100.0 role sequence, a real partial inline apply followed by boundary-only retry with dependent snapshot drift, binding and guard refusals.
- node --test scripts/test-bootstrap-saved-plan-offline.mjs: 7 passed, 0 failed/skipped, log tmp/offline-final-3.log. Real Terraform 1.16.1 outputs-only/stale/targeted behavior, real HTTP backend state-persistence failure, fresh consumer show/locked provider/tampered lock/backend re-init, real partial apply through production hold path, real AWS provider key/table plans and partial subsets. Synthetic credentials and loopback only.
- node --test scripts/test-bootstrap-saved-plan-apply.mjs: 29 passed, 0 failed/skipped, log tmp/outcome-check-3.log. Includes original 27 fault cases, hold-read check, serial race. Also passed remotely in the focused batch tmp/focused-final-4.log.
- node --test scripts/test-workflow-plan-artifacts.mjs: 4 passed, log tmp/plan-artifact-final.log.
- node --test --test-name-pattern='privileged manual jobs|PR Redis plan guard' scripts/test-terraform-pr-plan-gate.mjs: 3 passed, log tmp/actor-pr-gate-final.log.
- node --test scripts/test-bootstrap-saved-plan-routes.mjs: 8 passed, log tmp/dispatch-matrix-fixed.log. Actual workflow defaults and mixed input families tested through Bash and CLI. It caught an &&/set-e issue; explicit refusal now stops infra_only/replacement/disarm, plus release/evidence/runtime/repository combinations.
- npm test: reached explicit one-hour limit and exited 124 on an earlier candidate snapshot. Main segment: 7018 tests, 6985 passed, 15 failed, 1 cancelled, 17 skipped. Pretest had 1924 passing tests plus other passing segments. Do not sum counts or imply green. Four workflow static-check issues from the new route were fixed and their focused checks passed (actor matrix, PR-only source extraction, private plan naming, existing encrypted storage step). Remaining observed failures in unchanged tests: paused ClickHouse migration containers; provider zip download connection reset; rewards metadata expected exit42 got0; private ECS test file cancelled at limit. No expected test result weakened.
- npm run localstack:bootstrap: exit1. Terraform init/apply against LocalStack Pro4.9.0 SUCCEEDED. State has context, github_oidc, github_sst_deploy_roles, state_backend outputs and no package_summary. Then existing plan-role providers/example secret-read assertion expected explicitDeny but got allowed. Base and current role-source bytes and pure policy evaluator are identical; exact base also returns allowed. Proof tmp/bootstrap-baseline-proof.json, base da27d69b7, role SHA256 4dcb7c3321c22f734006c667ea35ad01dc5c1b87a195fa8690f1585b4ac016f0. Expected denial retained. Do NOT alter protected gha-plan role policy on this change. Full smoke gate remains unsatisfied; this needs an acceptance decision or separate policy fix. No assertion was weakened. Evidence tmp/localstack-runs/2026-11-11T15-40-22-520Z/summary.json.

Docs touched: README.md; terraform/Overview.md; scripts/runbooks/bootstrap-saved-plan.md (new), bootstrap-plan-ci.md, github-sst-deploy-roles.md.
No new env inputs. Remaining build-spec name references belong to dev/staging/prod roots and their unchanged embedded spec. No harness mirror needed: no harness bootstrap root/state-key reference.

Scope/size call: keep producer/binding/guard/recovery plus their tests together as one consistent apply path at the same head. 32 files, 2233 added/83 removed staged at this time; fixture policy/trust fields come from pinned 1018/1020, unrelated simulation/source fields removed. Do not mention internal assignments or processes.
Followup before any first live run: extend scripts/dev-claim.mjs mutation job inventory to include bootstrap-saved-plan-apply; current fixed list contains only terraform and terraform-saved-plan-apply. Named in runbook, deliberately outside this implementation's exact scope. First outputs-only live run belongs to separate authorized work. Wiki has old local instructions marked superseded; replacement follows the first live run.

No AWS writes, live Terraform plans/applies, workflow dispatches, tags, settings changes, merges, external comments or messages were performed. Test Terraform writes were loopback/LocalStack only. GitHub PR creation/push is authorized but not done yet.

Private validation report for card only, not needed in PR body: models tmp/quint/2516/bootstrap.qnt, approval.qnt, retry.qnt. Each fixed model passes quint run 10000 samples, max steps30/40, and quint verify max steps8, JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk, unique port9316. Old models violate serialSafety/cryptoSafety/decryptAvailable/metadataAvailable/recoveryReady/dispatchSafety/noStaleInline/validRetryAvailable. Actual old-code repros under tmp/first-safety-check/regressions.json and tmp/second-safety-check/regressions.json show unsafe old hold-clear, missing grants, Deny/? bypass and wrong emergency alias; fixed code refuses or retains correctly. Models stay local, not in PR.

Potential owner acceptance question (draft, NOT YET SENT; wait until concrete PR/CI is available): The task requires smoke still passing, but its unchanged baseline secret-read assertion fails and the protected policy is owned by separate work. Ask whether code-only change may advance with that failure documented and no live-run permission, or must wait for the policy fix, or be dropped. Explicitly changing secret permissions/test expected denial is not proposed. Avoid promising any CI status yet.
